nodes.name: GET /webhook/whatsapp (Meta verify)
nodes.notes: Meta calls this once when you save the webhook URL in the app dashboard.

nodes.name: Verify token matches?
nodes.notes: hub.mode must be "subscribe" and hub.verify_token must equal WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN.

nodes.name: Return hub.challenge
nodes.notes: Echoes hub.challenge as plain text (not JSON), which is what Meta checks.

nodes.name: POST /webhook/whatsapp (messages)
nodes.notes: Meta posts messages and status updates here; answered 200 at once so Meta does not retry.

nodes.name: Check Meta signature
nodes.notes: Rejects anything not signed with your Meta app secret.

nodes.name: Extract messages
nodes.notes: Turns the Meta payload into one lead item per text/button message; ignores status updates.

nodes.name: Qualify lead (core)
nodes.notes: Runs the shared lead core for each message; the core sends the WhatsApp reply.

parameters.content:
## WhatsApp entry
Meta needs a public HTTPS URL (see README: tunnel profile).
Callback URL: `<N8N_WEBHOOK_URL>/webhook/whatsapp`
Verify token: `WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN`
Subscribe to the **messages** field.

Verification pattern (Text response, `$json.query['hub.challenge']`) from the n8n community thread linked in the README.
